META_TITLE: Google Drive Backup — Your Data, Your Drive | FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin can save a backup copy of your finance data to your own Google Drive, restorable on any device. Export or delete your data any time. Free to start.
OG_DESCRIPTION: A backup copy of your FincWin data in your own Google Drive. Restore on any device. Free.
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: Save a backup copy to a Drive file you own and control. Restore on any device.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: A second copy, in a place you control
PROBLEM_BODY:
Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time.

Google Drive backup adds a separate copy in your own Drive — a file you hold yourself and can restore from on any device.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Connect Google Drive — authorise once; FincWin only touches its own backup file.
  • Back up — a copy of your data is saved to your Drive.
  • Switch devices — open FincWin anywhere and restore from Drive.
  • Stay in control — the file is yours; delete it any time.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Backup copy in your own Drive.
  • ✓Restore anywhere — move between phone and desktop.
  • ✓Export or delete — export or permanently delete your data at any time.
  • ✓You own the file — full control, delete any time.
  • ✓Scoped access — FincWin only sees its own backup file.
  • ✓On your schedule — back up when it suits you.
